claims.object_text: transcription factor important for normal brain development and function
claims.quote: FOXG1 (Forkhead box g1) syndrome is a neurodevelopmental disorder caused by a defective transcription factor, FOXG1, important for normal brain development and function.

claims.object_text: decrease in mitochondrial content and ATP levels and morphological changes in mitochondrial network in patient fibroblasts
claims.quote: We observed a significant decrease in mitochondrial content and adenosine triphosphate (ATP) levels and morphological changes in mitochondrial network in the fibroblasts of affected individuals

claims.object_text: involvement of mitochondrial dysfunction in FOXG1 syndrome pathogenesis
claims.quote: indicating involvement of mitochondrial dysfunction in FOXG1 syndrome pathogenesis.
